description: Refactor openspec ralph to generate iteration prompts directly instead of delegating to opsx-ralph skill

tasks.title: Add buildIterationPrompt() to ralph.ts
tasks.description: Add buildIterationPrompt(changeName, instructions) function in src/commands/workflow/ralph.ts. It calls generateRalphInstructions() to get latest state, selects the next pending task (lowest priority where passes:false), and returns a pure natural language prompt string containing absolute paths to all context files, the selected task details (id, title, description, acceptanceCriteria, spec), step-by-step execution instructions, and the <promise>COMPLETE</promise> completion signal instruction. When all tasks are complete, return '<promise>COMPLETE</promise>' directly.
acceptanceCriteria: Function exists and is exported
Prompt contains absolute paths via path.resolve()
Prompt contains only the next pending task (lowest priority)
Prompt includes spec reference path if task has spec field
Returns <promise>COMPLETE</promise> when all tasks done
Typecheck passes

tasks.title: Refactor iteration loop to use direct prompt
tasks.description: Modify the iteration loop in ralphCommand() to: (1) call generateRalphInstructions() at the start of each iteration for fresh state, (2) check if all tasks complete and exit early, (3) call buildIterationPrompt() to generate the prompt, (4) spawn opencode run with the prompt string instead of --command opsx-ralph. The spawn command format: opencode run [--model X] '<prompt>'. Keep the Executor interface unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Loop calls generateRalphInstructions() each iteration
Loop exits early when all tasks complete
Loop passes prompt to opencode run, not --command flag
Executor.executeOpenCode() still receives a single string
Completion signal <promise>COMPLETE</promise> detection unchanged
Typecheck passes
